I booked the bus from Larkin Bas Terminal to Mersing and it took around 2 hours 15mins to travel end to end. The bus arrived the lot before the stated timing and it departed 5 minutes behind schedule timing.

I think there was a transfer of goods as it made a quick stop outside Larkin Terminal and one of the petrol kiosk along the way. 

The traffic overall was relatively smooth
